if.test: region != null and region != '' and region != '전체 지역'

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY FAV_COUNT DESC, T.CONTENT_ID DESC

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TOUR_PLACE T LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD

SELECT T.CONTENT_ID, T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID, T.CATEGORY_ID, C.NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, T.TITLE AS TITLE, T.FIRST_IMAGE AS FIRST_IMAGE, T.FIRST_IMAGE2 AS FIRST_IMAGE2, T.ADDR1 AS ADDR1, T.ADDR2 AS ADDR2, T.MAP_X, T.MAP_Y, T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD, L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM AS L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, T.VIEW_COUNT, COUNT(F.FAVORITE_ID) AS FAVORITE_COUNT, COUNT(R.REVIEW_ID) AS REVIEW_COUNT FROM TOUR_PLACE T LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C ON T.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD LEFT JOIN FAVORITE F ON T.CONTENT_ID = F.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON T.CONTENT_ID = R.CONTENT_ID AND R.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y' WHERE T.CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} GROUP BY T.CONTENT_ID, T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID, T.CATEGORY_ID, C.NAME, T.TITLE, T.FIRST_IMAGE, T.FIRST_IMAGE2, T.ADDR1, T.ADDR2, T.MAP_X, T.MAP_Y, T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD, L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, T.VIEW_COUNT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE (USER_ID, CONTENT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentId}, NOW())
